Epi and Didge — installing on Linux
===================================

Copy each format you want into its folder. The same paths apply to both
plugins.

  Epi.vst3   ->  ~/.vst3/
  Epi.clap   ->  ~/.clap/
  Epi        ->  anywhere; it runs on its own, no host needed

Then restart your host so it rescans. The standalone needs the webkit2gtk
4.1 (or 4.0) runtime, which every mainstream distribution packages.
